answer: The system gives weight only to identities that pay rent of 100 units every 7 days from their own balance, so each fake funds its own rent and a missed payment zeroes weight for 30 days. At enrollment a ferrous plate stamped for that identity is sealed in its box at 50 grams; an audit fails if the plate is lighter by more than 0.1 gram or shared between boxes. The box is carried across a 20-meter canyon bridge in one trip, and a quartz seal across its lid must arrive unbroken. A failed check burns that rent, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 units per week.
